usage: Use LATTICE_SESSION_ID for canonical explicit ownership, or run host dispatch through Lattice so Codex, Claude Code, and Antigravity subprocesses receive canonical owner-session env. Verify with npm --prefix packages/main run test:story-owner-lease-smoke, npm --prefix packages/main run test:owner-session-guardrail, lattice validate --story=B-9089 --json, and lattice review_escalation_status --storyId=B-9089 --json.
expectedOutcome: Validation should pass with 21/21 verification intents covered, review assurance should report full-3x2, and session ownership should not flip when shell parent/session ids change if canonical env, host adapter, or generated token resolution is available.
actualTranscript: lattice validate --story=B-9089 --json passed with allPass:true and 21/21 verification coverage. story-owner-lease-smoke and owner-session-guardrail passed. review_escalation_status reports assuranceLevel:full-3x2 across round-1, round-2, and round-3 with Codex and Antigravity pass verdicts. lattice codex verify passed 7/8 with one non-hard global fallback heartbeat warning.
outcomeDiff: No owner-session behavior gap remains against the expected contract. The only known caveat is non-product evidence posture: Authority and production receipt completion are false, so completion is local Lattice assurance only.
limitations: Authority/productionDone is not claimed. Generated token fallback is local runtime coordination only. Derived ppid fallback remains degraded and is no longer primary when explicit env, host adapter, or generated token exists. Codex global fallback heartbeat warning remains advisory.
pitfalls: Claude Code CLI plan review was unavailable due an execution error, so two-host evidence used Codex and Antigravity. One high test-coverage finding required a DEV rollback and extra generated-token non-collision tests across project root, provider, and boundary. Later review prompts were constrained to evidence-only verdicts to avoid slow full re-analysis.
